data.narrative:
Velaura AI is a Series C-stage semiconductor company founded by Rajiv Khemani, Barun Kar, Saptadeep Pal, and Patrick Xu that has raised $343M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 8 private peers in Chips & Semiconductors at the same stage, supplemented by 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression anchors to the $343M total raised, applying a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $583M. Peer-median valuation uses 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables—Etched ($5.0B), d-Matrix ($2.0B), and DEEPX ($529M)—which produce a median of $2.0B. A public-comp approach via P/S multiples (median 21.4x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures, standard for private companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $496M to $2.3B, with a median of $1.3B. The wide spread reflects meaningful divergence between stage-based methods and peer comparables, particularly the high variance among private peers ($529M to $5.0B). Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers, product-market penetration trajectory, and whether the company's technology profile aligns with the higher or lower end of the peer range. Revenue disclosure would enable P/S anchoring and narrow the band materially.
